provablyFair.subtitle: How players verify that game results were not manipulated.
provablyFair.howText: Before each game round, the result is locked in cryptographically. The casino publishes a hash of its secret server seed in advance, your browser contributes a client seed you can change at any time, and a nonce counts your bets. The outcome is derived from all three — so neither side can change the result after the fact.
provablyFair.serverText: A long random secret generated by the platform. Only its SHA-256 hash is shown before you play. After you rotate seeds, the old server seed is revealed so you can check that its hash matches what was published — proving it never changed mid-session.
provablyFair.clientText: A value you control. Because it is mixed into every result, the platform cannot precompute favourable outcomes: it would need to know your seed in advance.
provablyFair.nonceText: A counter that increases with every bet you place under the same seed pair. It guarantees each round gets a unique, verifiable result even though the seeds stay fixed.
provablyFair.verifyText: Take the revealed server seed, your client seed and the round's nonce, run them through the published HMAC-SHA256 formula, and compare the derived result with what the game showed. Any mismatch would prove manipulation.
provablyFair.demoNote: This page is an educational explainer. The demo build does not run real game rounds, so there are no live seeds to verify.
